title: libultrahdr encodes an SDR and HDR pair into an Ultra HDR JPEG with a gain map
summary: Generated 128x96 SDR RGBA8888 and HLG RGBA1010102 pair; ultrahdr_app encodes one JPEG with MPF gain map, a plain reader decodes the SDR base, the library decodes HDR back. XMP hdrgm check is a KNOWN FAIL: 2.0.2 writes ISO 21496-1 metadata.
